title: Back to Florida: sending home for money; Hartwell and Moore stay
summary: The band sends home for train fare while Jimmy Hartwell and Vic Moore remain in Florida.

story.theme_name: Making a living: hard times, day jobs and scarce work
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters

blocks.x: Yes she is. I want to go back now to an earlier point when we had you stranded in Florida. (LAUGHTER).
Man, let's get out of Florida.
And you were sick and could not eat the King Fish. (LAUGHTER).
Well actually what happened Helen was we had to send home for money. There were no

jobs down there and we were travelling musicians and couldn't work steady, couldn't get another job. So we just finally had to send, I had to send home for money and we all did as a matter of fact. Send home for money and train fare home, but a couple of the guys stayed down there. Vic Moore the drummer and the clarinet player, Jimmy Hartwell.
Well, Jimmy Hartwell got a job, the clarinet player, and Vic Moore's father was in real estate in Palm Beach so he got.....
He wasn't exactly a poor boy then?
